skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand fundamental terms related to informatics, electronic computers, management information systems, computer networks, and information security.
Understand the function of each part of an electronic computer and the role of different types of computer networks.
Understand the role of an operating system for an electronic computer and use basic Windows 10 operating system.
Understand the principles of managing resources in a computer to manage programs and data scientifically, ensuring quick and accurate access.
Possess basic practical skills with core modules in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams).
Possess the ability to self-study, read documents, and use computer software.
Possess the ability to work independently or actively, positively, and effectively in group activities.
Possess the ability to organize group activities.
Possess social responsibility and class discipline awareness, follow classroom rules, and have a sense of cooperation and personal responsibility for assigned activities by instructors.
Understand the concept of information security and perform basic maintenance on computers.
